audience: real estate agents and teams who manage leads and deals in Follow Up Boss

useCases.title: Review new leads and where they came from
useCases.text: The AI searches people by criteria, reads lead events, and counts leads per lead source and agent with the conversion rate.

useCases.title: Find, create, complete or reassign tasks
useCases.text: The AI lists tasks that are due today, overdue or upcoming, creates a task for a contact, and marks a task complete or reassigns it.

useCases.title: Catch up on a lead's calls, texts and appointments
useCases.text: The AI reads the logged calls, text messages and appointments of one person, so you know where the lead stands before you call.

useCases.title: Check deals by stage, create or move one
useCases.text: The AI lists deals with stage, price and agents, and creates a deal in a pipeline stage or moves one to another stage.

useCases.title: Check if a lead exists, then add or update it
useCases.text: The AI checks by email or phone whether a contact exists and who has it. It then sends in a new lead or updates the contact's fields.

useCases.title: Add a note or log a call on a lead
useCases.text: The AI adds a note to a contact's timeline, or records a phone call made outside Follow Up Boss with its outcome.
